reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in #central-team and saved the correction in the brain: the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is **87 seats**, replacing the 268 he posted this morning.

I couldn't remove the old figure. I tried to find the brain's record of the 268 message so I could withdraw it, but my searches came back empty. Those searches only match exact keywords, so the record may still be there. If so, anyone who looks up this account could see both numbers. My new note says plainly that 87 replaces 268 and that 268 came from the wrong line, with Hollis's message as the source.
